paragraphs.text: Syr Gwyn , Hero of Ashvale , is a human knight of Eldraine .

Syr Gwyn is a legendary knight of Eldraine. She is a renowned warrior who is known for leading from the front and inspiring her troops to match her ferocity. It is said that squires throughout the realm aspire to be like her.
Syr Gwyn is believed to have survived the New Phyrexian Invasion .
